title: New lower bounds for Erdős–Szekeres numbers in three and four dimensions: coordinates, certificates and checks
description:
We construct eleven integer points in general position in four-dimensional space and fifteen in three-dimensional space with no eight of them in convex position, and thirteen integer points in four-dimensional space and eighteen in three-dimensional space with no nine of them in convex position. Hence g(4)(8) ≥ 12, so that by Scheucher's upper bound g(4)(8) is 12 or 13, g(3)(8) ≥ 16, g(4)(9) ≥ 14 and g(3)(9) ≥ 19 (previously 11, 14, 13 and 15). Each proof is a certificate: 28, 161, 46 and 282 integer identities that each place one point strictly inside a simplex spanned by others, such that every k points contain the support of one of them.

preprintErdosSzekeresHighDim/ holds the paper as a PDF; paper/ holds the LaTeX source (REVTeX 4.2) with six 3D figures; dist/ holds the PDF, the LaTeX source zip and the arXiv tarball; MasterErdosSzekeresHighDim_masterzipfinal2.zip holds every file of the repository. highdim/ holds the point sets, the certificates and the search, polishing, rounding and certificate programs. checks/ holds independent exact checks in Python, C, C++ and Julia, and a Lean 4 file in which the kernel proves general position, the relations and the covering condition. scripts/run_all.sh runs every check.
